Lena / Tom,

Huge thanks again — thrilled to have AnchorPoint on Redwood. We received the signed SOW this morning. Attached is SOW v1.2 for your records and the mutual action plan (MAP) that maps milestones to owners. High level next steps: 

- Kickoff: schedule in week of July 5 (customer prefers mornings PT)
- Discovery: 1 week (data & integration inventory)
- Pilot deployment: 3 weeks (staging -> acceptance)
- Go-live target: Aug 2 (tentative)

I've looped in Jasmine (onboarding lead) and Vivek (CS manager) who will own the delivery. Jasmine — please pick up the MAP and confirm owners/timezones. Vivek — we'll need CS coverage and remediation SLAs defined for production.

Attachments: AnchorPoint_SOW_v1.2.pdf; AnchorPoint_MAP.xlsx

Aditya

From: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@anchorpointhealth.com>, Tom Bryce <tbryce@anchorpointhealth.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-22 08:30 PDT
Subject: Re: AnchorPoint — post-signature: post-signature runbook & owner assignments

Lena / Tom — thanks and congrats. I'm the onboarding lead and will coordinate the delivery schedule and runbook. Below is an initial sales->CS handoff summary and proposed owners. Please reply with availability for a 60-min kickoff.

Summary (deal context)
- Product: hosted inference (chat + embeddings) behind VPC peering; reserved concurrency for predictable latency
- Initial monthly volume: ~10k inference tokens; expect burst testing during pilot
- Success criteria for pilot: 95th percentile latency < 350ms for text-gen through our t2-small profile; embeddings within 120ms.

Owners / Roles
- Customer PM: Lena Ortiz (AnchorPoint)
- Customer Infra: Tom Bryce (AnchorPoint)
- Redwood Onboarding Lead: Jasmine Liu — overall delivery, acceptance criteria, cadence
- Redwood CS Manager: Vivek Kulkarni — SLA owner, escalation
- Redwood Implementation Engineer: Monica Patel — integration, infra validation, runbook ops
- Redwood Security SME (support): Rishi Malhotra (cc on security thread if needed)

Planned milestones & dates (tentative)
- Discovery (data & infra inventory): Jul 6–9 — owners: Monica & Tom
- Integration validation (S3 + DB access): Jul 10–14 — owners: Monica & Tom
- Pilot deployment to staging: Jul 15–21 — owners: Monica & Jasmine
- Acceptance window & QA: Jul 22–28 — owners: AnchorPoint & Redwood
- Go/no-go review & production plan: Jul 29 — owners: Vivek, Jasmine, Lena

Kickoff agenda (60 min)
1) Introductions & roles (5 min)
2) SOW & MAP walkthrough (10 min)
3) Data/access checklist (15 min)
4) Integration plan & testing windows (15 min)
5) Risks, SLAs, support model (10 min)

Immediate asks for kickoff prep
- Customer: please share the S3 bucket name and an IAM user with read/list access by Jul 1. If you have a preflight checklist, attach it.
- Redwood: we'll share the onboarding checklist and preflight security Q by EOD today.

Attachments I will share after this thread: redwood_onboarding-checklist.pdf (checklist + test cases).

Proposed kickoff options (all PT mornings):
- Tue Jul 6, 9:30–10:30am
- Thu Jul 8, 9:00–10:00am

Lena / Tom — which works best?

Thanks — Jasmine
Onboarding Lead, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai

Date: 2027-06-22 11:02 PDT
Subject: Re: AnchorPoint — post-signature runbook & owner assignments

Thanks Jasmine — I confirm CS ownership. I'll be the escalation contact through pilot and production. Key notes from my side: 

- Support model: Business hours response for pilot (M-F 8am–6pm PT), with on-call rotation for critical incidents.
- SLA exceptions: given the latency targets, if we detect degradation > 3 consecutive days we'll trigger a priority remediation path (engineer + infra).
- Reporting: we'll run weekly health reports and an SLO dashboard share (I own dashboard setup).

Monica — please call out any infra blockers for S3 peering / VPC options in your plan. Aditya — happy to join the kickoff to introduce CS if helpful.

Vivek
Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

I'll kick off a staging deployment as soon as we have S3 access. Attachment: small runbook excerpt with checklist items.
